previous.changeLog:
Fixed a phantom Potential Tier XI bar. Tier-X vehicles whose Tier XI successor you have already researched no longer show a stray "potential" bar.
Fixed the Tier XI skill-tree "done" marker. Completing the upgrade tree now correctly turns the chip into its green done marker even when there's no remaining frontier.
Fixed the saved bar position drifting between resolutions. The bar's position is no longer stored as raw pixels, so it stays where you put it when your screen resolution or window size changes. (Existing setups: use Reset if the bar lands off-screen.)
Smoother hovering and no more stale tooltips. Reduced per-frame work while hovering the bar, and tooltips no longer linger after the underlying tick changes.

current.changeLog: Coexists with other Gameface mods. The bar now detects which garage sub-views are already occupied and places itself on the first free one, so it no longer blanks out (or gets blanked by) other Gameface-based mods. If you ran into two garage bars fighting over the same spot, this fixes it.

In-game settings + cleaner defaults:
NEW
- In-game configurator: with a mods-settings menu installed (Aslain's aslainMenu, or izeberg's ModsSettingsAPI - both optional, the mod works without either) SpotMeter gets a settings page: panel visibility, identical-tank grouping, auto-hide, panel hotkey (key combos supported), minimap circle on/off, circle opacity, language, the battle-start loadout, per-class auto-pick presets (class dropdown), and a full rebindable hotkey list. Changes apply live and save to spotmeter.json.
- "Panel only" mode: showMinimapCircle turns the minimap circle off independently of the panel.
CHANGED
- The battle panel starts HIDDEN by default (PageDown shows it). The separate garage panel is gone - its settings live in the configurator now.
- Config moved to AppData (survives modpack reinstalls); an old config is migrated automatically.
Responsive battle panel scaling + save position in fullscreen/windowed; remove title; v - 2.0.1
